choices.why: Tall, wide solid-wood bookcase in dark brown that matches the floor and fills the left wall to hold many books.
Rolled-arm armchair in warm beige fabric is comfortable for long reading and suits the natural-textile look.
Tall rice paper floor lamp gives soft, warm light and uses a natural material that fits the cozy theme.
Round walnut-finish side table at the right height for coffee, with wood tones that echo the floor and bookcase.
Round braided jute rug in a light natural tone adds warmth and texture under the chair and table.
Beige cable-knit throw is a natural, cozy textile that complements the armchair.
Beige linen curtains add warmth and a natural texture that matches the room's palette.

answer.why: Warm wood, beige and natural fibers (linen, jute, rice paper, knit) work together so the reading corner feels cohesive and cozy. The dark wood bookcase echoes the floor, while the light textiles soften the concrete ceiling and white walls.
